name: Cayuga County, NY
findings: Cayuga County has 249 nonprofit organizations. 116 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 97 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Cayuga County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 17 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
